_comment: Reference values for lammps-thermal-conductivity. kappa/vol values below were measured with the MODIFIED LAMMPS (lammps_Ex0, serial build) on the shipped 1200-bead assets and verified end-to-end (verifier PASS on real production output). image_digest is still a PLACEHOLDER - replace it with the real 'docker inspect' digest of the built CI image before submission, and re-confirm kappa on the CI image (it should match within tolerance; update if the CI build differs slightly).
_calibration_note: Single-threaded deterministic runs on pinned equilibrated assets -> oracle kappa is exact for the asset (T1=1.184, T04=2.550, kappa lower at higher T: sticker association makes the melt stiffer at T*=0.4). The CoM fix keeps only LINEAR momentum (removing angular momentum cools a 1200-bead system: T drifted 0.99->0.76 in an earlier run). Tolerances sized for protocol-implementation variance (zero-crossing cutoff shifts) and the raw-series-vs-ave/correlate estimator difference.
